name: Japan cherry blossom
tips: Tokyo and Kyoto usually peak from late March to early April. Bloom forecasts are published from January, so keep dates flexible.
crowd_note: Very busy with domestic and international visitors. Early April can overlap China's Qingming break.

name: Japan autumn leaves
tips: Kyoto usually peaks mid to late November, Tokyo late November to early December. Visit temples at opening time.
crowd_note: Famous Kyoto temples are packed on weekends. Generally quieter than cherry blossom season.

name: Hokkaido skiing
tips: Niseko and Furano have world-famous powder, best in January and February. Book lift passes and lodging early.
crowd_note: Niseko fills with Australians during the January school holidays. Chinese New Year is also busy.

name: Sapporo Snow Festival
tips: Runs for about a week in early February with giant snow and ice sculptures. Exact dates change each year.
crowd_note: Hotels sell out months ahead. Can overlap Chinese New Year.

name: Beijing autumn foliage
tips: The Fragrant Hills red leaves usually peak from late October to early November. Pair with the Forbidden City and hutongs.
crowd_note: Avoid National Day Golden Week (1 to 7 October). Weekends at the Fragrant Hills are crowded.

name: Great Wall hiking
tips: Mutianyu, Jinshanling and Jiankou are quieter and more scenic than Badaling. Spring and autumn have the best hiking weather.
crowd_note: Avoid May Day and National Day holidays, when popular sections are packed.

name: Harbin Ice and Snow Festival
tips: The ice city opens in early January. Night-time temperatures can drop below minus 25 degrees, so pack serious thermals.
crowd_note: Very busy around New Year and Spring Festival.

name: Zhangjiajie and Guilin
tips: Zhangjiajie's sandstone pillars and a Li River cruise from Guilin to Yangshuo. Autumn is clearer and drier than spring.
crowd_note: National Day Golden Week is extremely crowded. Mid-October onwards is much better.

name: Yunnan (Kunming, Dali, Lijiang)
tips: Spring dry season brings clear skies and flowers. Add Shangri-La for Tibetan culture.
crowd_note: Qingming and May Day breaks are busy. March is the quietest window.

name: Seoul in autumn
tips: Palaces and Bukhansan National Park are at their best with autumn colours. Easy to add Busan by fast train.
crowd_note: Busy around Chuseok (Korean Thanksgiving), which moves each year.

name: Taiwan
tips: Taipei night markets, Taroko Gorge and Jiufen. Avoid typhoon season from July to September.
crowd_note: Many businesses close for Lunar New Year.

name: Okinawa beaches
tips: Subtropical islands with clear water. The rainy season runs from about May to June and typhoons peak August to September.
crowd_note: Japanese Golden Week (late April to early May) is the domestic peak.

name: Climbing Mt Fuji
tips: The official climbing season runs roughly from early July to early September. Trails have fees and the Yoshida trail needs a booking.
crowd_note: Mid-August (Obon) is the busiest time on the mountain.

name: Jeju Island
tips: Canola fields and cherry blossoms in spring, volcanic hikes up Hallasan and coastal walking trails.
crowd_note: Korean public holidays and summer school holidays are busy.

name: Shanghai and Hangzhou
tips: West Lake in spring blossom or with osmanthus in September. Shanghai is a short fast-train ride away.
crowd_note: Qingming and May Day breaks are crowded at West Lake.

name: Xinjiang (Kanas and Ili)
tips: Kanas and Hemu autumn colours peak mid to late September. Ili's lavender blooms in June and July. Distances are huge.
crowd_note: Summer school holidays and National Day are busy. Allow extra time for security checks.

name: Tibet (Lhasa)
tips: Foreign visitors need a Tibet Travel Permit arranged through a licensed agency. Lhasa sits at about 3,650 m, so plan for acclimatisation.
crowd_note: Summer school holidays are the peak. Access can be restricted at short notice.

name: Jiuzhaigou Valley
tips: Turquoise lakes with autumn colour peaking mid to late October. Daily visitor numbers are capped, so book entry tickets ahead.
crowd_note: National Day Golden Week is extremely crowded. Go after 8 October.

name: Mongolia Naadam Festival
tips: Naadam is held around 11 to 13 July in Ulaanbaatar with wrestling, horse racing and archery. Add a ger camp stay.
crowd_note: Ulaanbaatar hotels sell out during Naadam.

name: Bali
tips: Dry season brings sunny days for Uluwatu beaches and Ubud rice terraces. About 3.5 hours from Perth.
crowd_note: Very busy with Australians during school holidays, especially July and late September to early October.

name: Thai islands (Phuket, Krabi)
tips: The Andaman coast is best November to April. The Gulf islands such as Koh Samui are better from January to August.
crowd_note: Christmas to New Year is the most expensive peak.

name: Ha Long Bay
tips: An overnight cruise among limestone karsts. Combine with Hanoi. Typhoons are possible July to September.
crowd_note: Vietnamese holidays around 30 April and 2 September are busy.

name: Angkor Wat
tips: The cool dry season is best for exploring temples. Buy a multi-day pass and go early for sunrise.
crowd_note: December and January are the busiest months.

name: Langkawi
tips: Duty-free island with beaches, mangrove tours and a sky bridge. Driest from December to March.
crowd_note: Malaysian school holidays and Chinese New Year are busy.

name: Palawan (El Nido and Coron)
tips: Island-hopping among lagoons and limestone cliffs. The dry season runs roughly December to May.
crowd_note: Holy Week around Easter is the local peak.

name: Komodo National Park
tips: See Komodo dragons and dive with manta rays. Most trips leave from Labuan Bajo, often on liveaboard boats.
crowd_note: July and August are the busiest months for boats.

name: Singapore
tips: Great short break, about 5 hours from Perth. Gardens by the Bay, hawker centres and Sentosa. February to April is drier.
crowd_note: Some shops and hawker stalls close for Chinese New Year.

name: Chiang Mai Yi Peng lantern festival
tips: Yi Peng and Loy Krathong fall on the full moon of the 12th Thai lunar month, usually in November. Confirm the exact dates each year.
crowd_note: Hotels book out months ahead.

name: Hoi An
tips: Lantern-lit old town, tailors and nearby beaches. Monthly full-moon lantern nights. Flooding is common in October and November.
crowd_note: Busy around Tet (Vietnamese New Year).

name: Luang Prabang
tips: Temples, the dawn alms giving and Kuang Si waterfalls. The cool dry season is the most pleasant.
crowd_note: December and January are the busiest months.

name: Borneo orangutans (Sabah)
tips: Sepilok rehabilitation centre, Kinabatangan River cruises and Mount Kinabalu. Drier from March to October.
crowd_note: Kinabalu climbing permits are limited and sell out.

name: Raja Ampat
tips: Some of the world's richest coral reefs. Remote, so allow extra travel days. Liveaboards are the easiest way to dive.
crowd_note: Rarely crowded, but liveaboards book out early.

name: Maldives
tips: The dry north-east monsoon brings calm seas and clear water. Resorts are reached by speedboat or seaplane.
crowd_note: Prices peak over Christmas, New Year and Chinese New Year.

name: Rajasthan and the Taj Mahal
tips: Jaipur, Jodhpur and Udaipur forts and palaces, plus Agra for the Taj Mahal. Summer is extremely hot.
crowd_note: Diwali (October or November) is festive but busy.

name: Everest Base Camp trek
tips: The classic trek takes about 12 to 14 days from Lukla. October and November have the clearest mountain views.
crowd_note: October is the busiest trekking month. Spring is a good alternative with rhododendrons.

name: Dubai
tips: Direct flights from Perth. Desert safaris, the Burj Khalifa and beach clubs. Summer temperatures exceed 40 degrees.
crowd_note: Christmas to New Year is the peak. Ramadan changes opening hours.

name: Petra and Wadi Rum
tips: Walk the Siq to the Treasury early, then camp in Wadi Rum and float in the Dead Sea. The Jordan Pass covers entry and visa.
crowd_note: Spring and autumn are popular; midday heat is tough in summer.

name: Cappadocia and Istanbul
tips: Sunrise hot-air balloon flights over fairy chimneys, cave hotels and Istanbul's bazaars. Flights depend on the weather, so allow spare mornings.
crowd_note: Balloon flights book out in peak season.

name: Sri Lanka
tips: The south and west coasts and the hill country are best December to April. The east coast is best May to September.
crowd_note: Christmas and New Year are the busiest period.

name: Bhutan
tips: Tiger's Nest monastery and colourful tshechu festivals in autumn. A daily Sustainable Development Fee applies to visitors.
crowd_note: Festival dates draw the biggest crowds.

name: Kerala
tips: Houseboat cruises on the backwaters, tea hills in Munnar and Ayurvedic retreats.
crowd_note: Christmas and New Year are busy along the coast.

name: Uzbekistan Silk Road
tips: Samarkand, Bukhara and Khiva linked by fast trains. Summers are very hot.
crowd_note: Spring and autumn are popular with tour groups.

name: Oman
tips: Wadis, desert camps in Wahiba Sands, mountain villages and Muscat. Self-drive friendly.
crowd_note: Generally uncrowded. Ramadan changes opening hours.

name: Paris
tips: Spring gardens and long evenings. Book the Louvre and Eiffel Tower ahead. Easy day trips to Versailles.
crowd_note: July and August are packed with tourists, and many local businesses close in August.

name: Amalfi Coast
tips: Positano, Ravello and boat trips to Capri. Many hotels close from November to March.
crowd_note: July and August bring peak prices and traffic.

name: Greek islands
tips: Santorini, Naxos, Milos and Crete. June and September are warm but calmer than mid-summer.
crowd_note: July and August are the busiest and most expensive months.

name: Swiss Alps summer hiking
tips: High trails are usually snow-free from late June. Base yourself in Zermatt, Grindelwald or Lauterbrunnen. A Swiss Travel Pass saves money.
crowd_note: July and August are busy around Jungfrau and the Matterhorn.

name: European Alps skiing
tips: Chamonix, Zermatt, St Anton and Val d'Isère. Snow is most reliable from January to March.
crowd_note: Avoid European school holiday weeks in February.

name: German and Austrian Christmas markets
tips: Nuremberg, Munich, Vienna and Salzburg. Most markets close by 23 or 24 December.
crowd_note: Weekend evenings are very crowded.

name: Iceland northern lights
tips: You need dark, clear skies. Combine aurora hunting with the Golden Circle, ice caves and hot springs. Winter daylight is very short.
crowd_note: Busiest around Christmas, New Year and February.

name: Norwegian fjords
tips: Geirangerfjord, the Flåm railway and long midnight-sun days. Expensive, so plan meals ahead.
crowd_note: Cruise ships crowd small fjord towns in July.

name: Spain (Barcelona, Madrid, Andalusia)
tips: Gaudí in Barcelona, the Prado in Madrid and the Alhambra in Granada. Seville is extremely hot in July and August.
crowd_note: Holy Week (Easter) and August are very busy.

name: London and the UK
tips: Long summer days for London, the Cotswolds and Edinburgh. Trains are cheaper booked ahead.
crowd_note: UK school holidays run from late July to August.

name: Rome and the Vatican
tips: Book timed tickets for the Vatican Museums and Colosseum. Early mornings are best for big sights.
crowd_note: Easter is extremely busy in Rome.

name: Dolomites hiking
tips: Tre Cime, Seceda and via ferrata routes. Most lifts and huts operate from mid-June to September.
crowd_note: August is the peak for Italian holidaymakers.

name: Lisbon, Porto and the Algarve
tips: Trams and viewpoints in Lisbon, port cellars in Porto and Algarve sea caves.
crowd_note: July and August are busy and hot in the south.

name: Croatia (Dubrovnik, Split, Plitvice)
tips: Walled old towns, island-hopping by ferry and Plitvice Lakes.
crowd_note: Cruise ships crowd Dubrovnik in July and August.

name: Amsterdam and the tulip fields
tips: Keukenhof gardens open from late March to mid May; the fields usually peak in mid-April. Rent bikes to see them.
crowd_note: King's Day (27 April) fills Amsterdam.

name: Provence lavender
tips: The Valensole plateau usually blooms from late June to mid July. Harvest starts from late July.
crowd_note: Popular photo spots are crowded at sunset.

name: Munich Oktoberfest
tips: Runs from mid-September to the first weekend of October. Tent reservations open months ahead.
crowd_note: Munich hotel prices spike during the festival.

name: Scottish Highlands
tips: Isle of Skye, Glencoe and the North Coast 500. Bring midge repellent for June to August.
crowd_note: Single-track roads get busy in summer.

name: Prague and Vienna
tips: Two classic capitals about 4 hours apart by train. Add Budapest or Salzburg.
crowd_note: Summer weekends are crowded on the Charles Bridge.

name: Finnish Lapland
tips: Husky sledding, reindeer farms, glass igloos and aurora in Rovaniemi or Saariselkä.
crowd_note: December around Santa Claus Village is the busiest and most expensive.

name: Kruger safari
tips: The dry winter thins out vegetation, making the Big Five easier to spot. There are direct flights from Perth to Johannesburg.
crowd_note: South African school holidays in late June and July are busy.

name: Great Migration (Kenya and Tanzania)
tips: Mara River crossings usually happen from July to October. Calving season in the southern Serengeti is January to February.
crowd_note: Crossing points are crowded with vehicles in August.

name: Morocco
tips: Marrakech souks, Fes medina, the Atlas Mountains and a Sahara desert camp.
crowd_note: Ramadan changes opening hours; summer is very hot inland.

name: Egypt (pyramids and the Nile)
tips: Giza pyramids, Luxor's temples and a Nile cruise to Aswan. Summer heat is extreme.
crowd_note: Christmas to New Year is the peak.

name: Victoria Falls
tips: Peak water flow is March to May, when spray can hide the view. May to August balances flow and visibility.
crowd_note: Generally manageable. Combine with a Chobe safari.

name: Cape Town and the Winelands
tips: Table Mountain, Cape Point, penguins at Boulders Beach and wine tasting in Stellenbosch.
crowd_note: December to January is the local summer holiday peak.

name: Gorilla trekking (Rwanda and Uganda)
tips: Permits are limited and expensive, so book months ahead. Expect steep, muddy hikes.
crowd_note: Permits for June to September sell out first.

name: Zanzibar
tips: Stone Town's history, spice tours and white-sand beaches. Pairs well after a safari.
crowd_note: Busy in July and August with European visitors.

name: Namibia (Sossusvlei and Etosha)
tips: Red dunes at Sossusvlei, Etosha's waterholes and the Skeleton Coast. Best as a self-drive.
crowd_note: Lodges in Etosha book out for July and August.

name: Okavango Delta
tips: Flood waters peak from June to August. Explore by mokoro canoe. Camps are remote and expensive.
crowd_note: Camps have few beds, so book early for peak season.

name: New York
tips: Autumn is mild with fall colours in Central Park. Thanksgiving and Christmas lights are festive but crowded.
crowd_note: Thanksgiving week and December are the busiest.

name: Canadian Rockies
tips: Banff, Lake Louise, Jasper and the Icefields Parkway. Moraine Lake is reached by shuttle only.
crowd_note: July and August are very busy; book lodging early.

name: US national parks (Grand Canyon, Zion, Yosemite)
tips: A road trip through the south-west parks. Some parks need timed-entry reservations in peak months.
crowd_note: Summer brings heat and crowds; autumn is calmer.

name: Hawaii
tips: Maui, the Big Island's volcanoes and Kauai's Na Pali coast. Humpback whales visit from December to April.
crowd_note: Christmas to New Year and US summer holidays are the peak.

name: Machu Picchu and Cusco
tips: The dry season is best. Inca Trail permits sell out months ahead and the trail closes in February. Acclimatise in Cusco first.
crowd_note: June to August is the busiest period.

name: Patagonia
tips: Torres del Paine, El Chaltén and the Perito Moreno glacier. Expect very strong winds.
crowd_note: Refugios in Torres del Paine book out for December to February.

name: Galápagos Islands
tips: December to May brings warm, calm seas. June to November is cooler with more marine life. Most visits are by small cruise.
crowd_note: Cruise spaces are limited around Christmas and Easter.

name: Day of the Dead (Mexico City and Oaxaca)
tips: Celebrations peak on 1 and 2 November with altars, parades and marigolds.
crowd_note: Oaxaca accommodation sells out months ahead.

name: Cancún and the Yucatán
tips: Beaches, cenotes, Tulum and Chichén Itzá. Hurricane season is June to November.
crowd_note: Spring break in March is busy and loud.

name: Rio de Janeiro Carnival
tips: Carnival moves with Easter, falling in February or early March (2027: about 6 to 9 February). Book Sambadrome tickets early.
crowd_note: Prices triple during Carnival week.

name: Iguazu Falls
tips: See both the Argentine and Brazilian sides. Autumn and spring avoid the summer heat.
crowd_note: Argentine holiday weekends are busy.

name: Alaska
tips: Inside Passage cruises, glaciers and Denali National Park. Late summer has the best chance of seeing bears catching salmon.
crowd_note: Cruise season peaks in July.

name: Yellowknife northern lights
tips: One of the most reliable places to see the aurora. Winter temperatures can reach minus 30 degrees; late August to September offers lakeside viewing in milder weather.
crowd_note: Chinese New Year is a popular time for aurora tours.

name: New England fall foliage
tips: Vermont, New Hampshire and Maine on a road trip. Colours move from north to south over a few weeks.
crowd_note: Columbus Day weekend in October is the busiest.

name: Uyuni salt flats
tips: The famous mirror effect appears in the wet season from January to March. The altitude is about 3,650 m.
crowd_note: Mirror-season tours fill up around Chinese New Year.

name: Queenstown skiing
tips: Coronet Peak, The Remarkables and Cardrona. Easy to combine with Wanaka.
crowd_note: Australian and NZ school holidays in July are the busiest.

name: Milford Track
tips: A 4-day Great Walk with huts that must be booked when bookings open, often selling out quickly. The season runs from late October to late April.
crowd_note: Hut bookings are the bottleneck, not crowds on the track.

name: Great Barrier Reef
tips: Snorkel and dive from Cairns, Port Douglas or the Whitsundays. Stinger season is November to May.
crowd_note: Australian school holidays fill reef tours.

name: Uluru and Kata Tjuta
tips: Cool days and cold nights. Sunrise and sunset viewing, the base walk and Kata Tjuta's Valley of the Winds. Summer often exceeds 40 degrees.
crowd_note: School holidays are busy and accommodation is limited.

name: Ningaloo Reef whale sharks
tips: Swim with whale sharks from Exmouth or Coral Bay, about a 2-hour flight from Perth. Humpback whales pass from June to November.
crowd_note: WA school holidays are the busiest; book tours early.

name: The Kimberley
tips: Broome, the Gibb River Road, the Bungle Bungles and Horizontal Falls. Wet-season roads close from about November to March.
crowd_note: The dry season is short, so tours fill quickly.

name: Tasmania
tips: Cradle Mountain, Freycinet and MONA in Hobart. Autumn brings the turning of the fagus in late April to early May.
crowd_note: The Christmas and January holidays are the peak.

name: Fiji
tips: Island resorts in the Mamanuca and Yasawa groups. Cyclone season is November to April.
crowd_note: Australian and NZ school holidays are busy.

name: Margaret River
tips: Wineries, caves and surf beaches about 3 hours from Perth. Vintage harvest runs roughly February to April.
crowd_note: Long weekends and school holidays fill accommodation.

name: WA wildflower season
tips: Blooms start in the north (Kalbarri) and move south. Kings Park hosts a festival in September.
crowd_note: Popular wildflower drives are busy on weekends.

name: Sydney New Year's Eve
tips: Harbour fireworks at 9 pm and midnight. Many vantage points are ticketed or need an early start.
crowd_note: Flights and hotels peak around 31 December.

name: Vivid Sydney
tips: Light installations around the harbour from late May to mid June. Dates change each year.
crowd_note: Weekends around Circular Quay are very crowded.
